blocks.rationale: The failed view confuses the domestic-service exclusion with its threshold exception. This terminal skill encodes §3306(c)(2): covered domestic service is excluded only while the employer's qualifying remuneration remains below $1,000; payment of $1,000 or more makes a claim that the exclusion applies contradictory.
